deadline.value: International applicants: January 8 for Fall (September) entry (Winter: March 15).
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 8 Winter (January) March 15

gre_subject.value: The program page does not mention the Mathematics GRE.

supervisor.value: You must select a Mathematics faculty member as supervisor before you are accepted.
supervisor.quote: Mathematics MSc and PhD programs are research-intensive and because of this, applicants are required to select one of our faculty members to be their supervisor and preside over an applicant’s program before they are accepted for admission.

funding.value: PhD students get CAD 23,000 a year (direct aid plus tutorial/marking work), guaranteed for four years subject to satisfactory performance.
funding.quote: Levels of support are $21,000 and $23,000 (CDN) per year for thesis-based MSc and PhD students, respectively, in the form of direct aid and tutorial/or marking employment. Stipends are guaranteed for two years for MSc students, and four years for PhD students, subject to satisfactory performance

entry_route.value: An MSc in Mathematics or equivalent is required.
entry_route.quote: To be considered for admission to the Mathematics (PhD) program, you must have: An MSc in Mathematics or its equivalent

notes: Application includes essay or math questions; PhD students teach at least two one-semester undergraduate courses.
